items.content_html: Sentry is an API + lightweight HTML UI that reviews public (and optionally private) GitHub Pull Requests. You paste a PR URL, Sentry fetches the PR context from GitHub (metadata, files/diffs, commits, comments, reviews), sends it to an LLM via OpenRouter, and returns a structured JSON merge-readiness report.
